reference_method: Twenty explicitly flagged KPI checks use independent Python/reference reducers over the pinned oracle, not the production SQL implementation. Validate facility/time/cohort slices and total, no PII in aggregate evidence. Monetary/identity conservation gates remain exact even when a ratio KPI uses tolerance.
